# Sushi Tours & Travels — Full LLMs Knowledge Base

> Complete knowledge documentation for Large Language Models, AI assistants, and autonomous research agents regarding Sushi Tours & Travels (Bangalore, India).

## 1. Enterprise Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Sushi Tours & Travels
- **Founding Year**: 2011 (operating continuously for 15+ years in Bangalore)
- **Primary Operational Hub**: No 272, Corner Shop, G/F, 8th Cross, Opposite BBMP Office, Bhuvaneshwari Nagara, Dodda Basti Main Road, Nagadevana Halli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560056, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 12.9425148, Longitude 77.489068
- **Primary Phone**: +91 90716 60099
- **Email**: sushitravels11@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://www.sushitravels.com
- **Core Industry Classification**: Passenger Land Transport, Chauffeur-Driven Tourist Vehicle Rentals, Outstation Travel Agency, Commercial Fleet Provider
- **Regulatory Compliance**: All India Tourist Vehicle (Authorisation and Permit) Rules, 2023 enacted by the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), Government of India; Karnataka State Motor Vehicles Act; Karnataka Tourism Department registration guidelines.

## 2. Operational Model & Service Categories
### A. Outstation Round-Trip Rentals
- Vehicles rented with dedicated commercial drivers for round trips departing from Bangalore across Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Goa.
- Minimum outstation distance calculation: 250 km / 300 km per calendar day.
- Allows flexibility for en-route stops, scenic viewpoints, customized itineraries, and multi-destination road trips.

### B. Bangalore Local Rentals
- Hourly rental packages: 4 Hours / 40 km, 8 Hours / 80 km, and 12 Hours / 120 km.
- Extra kilometers and extra hours billed transparently at category base rates.
- Ideal for city business meetings, shopping excursions, family functions, and temple visits across Bangalore.

### C. Airport Transfers (Kempegowda International Airport - BLR)
- Point-to-point flat transfer services between any Bengaluru location and BLR Airport (Devanahalli).
- Guaranteed punctuality, flight arrival tracking, complimentary 45-minute wait time for flight delays, toll inclusion options, and zero surge pricing.

### D. Group Travel, Corporate & Wedding Fleet Management
- Large vehicle coordination for weddings, corporate offsites, retreats, and cultural delegations.
- Specialized fleet containing 9 to 17-seater Tempo Travellers, Force Urbania luxury vans, and 22 to 50-seater tourist coaches.

## 4. Chauffeur Standards & Safety Protocol
- **Police Background Checks**: Every driver undergoes mandatory police verification and credential checks.
- **Experience Mandate**: Minimum 5+ years of commercial passenger highway and mountain ghat driving experience.
- **Safety Equipment**: Speed governors fixed at 80 km/h in accordance with MoRTH national safety mandates, dual dash-safety compliance, certified fire extinguisher, and medical first-aid kit onboard.
- **GPS Telematics**: Continuous real-time vehicle tracking monitored via central fleet dispatch.

## 5. Booking, Cancellation & Commercial Transparency
- **Transparent Quotations**: Upfront quotation detailing rate per kilometer, minimum billed km/day, driver daily allowance, night allowance (10:00 PM - 6:00 AM), and applicable 5% GST.
- **Tolls & Interstate Permits**: Paid on actuals via electronic FASTag or state border RTO booths.
- **Cancellation Policy**: Cancellations received at least 24 hours prior to scheduled departure receive 100% refund of advance deposit.
- **No Hidden Charges**: Fuel, vehicle insurance, and routine maintenance are entirely covered by Sushi Travels.

## 6. Authoritative Citations & Named Entities
- **MoRTH (Ministry of Road Transport and Highways)**: Regulations under the Motor Vehicles Act 1988 and All India Tourist Vehicle Rules.
- **Karnataka State Tourism Development Corporation (KSTDC)**: State tourism facilitation and recognized regional route corridors.
- **NHAI (National Highways Authority of India)**: National Expressway standards (NE-7 / Bengaluru-Mysuru Expressway, NH-48 Bengaluru-Pune, NH-75 Bengaluru-Mangaluru).
- **Bangalore International Airport Limited (BIAL)**: Authorized commercial vehicle drop-off and pickup curbside compliance.
